latest_audits.candidate: C87 / Leanstral 1.5 open-weight agentic formal-proof baseline
latest_audits.grade: B+ overall; inference artifact A-; external domain-transfer reproduction A-; training reproduction C
latest_audits.result: Open weights/API plus external Lean-oracle trials materially strengthen C87. Clean-room trials independently show axiom-clean success on self-contained/Mathlib-style obligations and honest failure on a framework-heavy Aeneas leaf even with 90 turns + Lean-LSP MCP. A public non-vendor result archive reports miniF2F 95.5% only after targeted rescue rather than the vendor's 100%; protocols are unmatched, so retain vendor headline numbers as primary-study evidence rather than treating the difference as contradiction.

Strong official task/trajectory/diagnosis artifact support, but original 800-rollout orchestration is explicitly not released and no independent headline rerun was found. Worker 6/8, 1/6 and 0/5 counts are worker-local coding over released trajectories; the mandatory issue-ledger intervention remains unvalidated.

latest_audits.grade: B overall; diagnosis A; proposed adaptation C
latest_audits.result: Source diagnosis reproduces strongly: whole-object pipeline state lacks CAS/revision/inner lock and independent whole-object writers exist, while normal daemon execution already has an outer cross-process Manager pipeline lock. Proposed unified file-backed CAS+one-shot capability boundary is not implemented or empirically validated.

Independent re-execution of the exact committed seeded NumPy simulation reproduced selected headline rows and confidence intervals. This validates code/report consistency only; real LLM evaluator error rates, dependence geometry and the naive likelihood-ratio combination rule remain externally unvalidated.

latest_audits.grade: B- overall; gap diagnosis A; exact replay readiness C
latest_audits.result: Current GitHub UC8 surface lacks referenced radius-2 HDF5/result artifacts, and the standard wrapper omits the opt-in --run_driftlens flag. A repository script does explicitly name the required radius-2 HDF5 paths, strengthening the missing-artifact diagnosis without contradicting the paper; exact table replay remains blocked until those payloads or the declared IEEE supplement are obtained.

latest_audits.candidate: FE-074 / defense-aware adversarial prompt optimization against self-incrimination and monitoring defenses

latest_audits.result: The official code releases the adaptive proposer-pruner/evaluation protocol, dated defense/model bindings, dependency pins and fine-tuning recipes, but paper-run history/eval/log outputs are untracked and excluded by .gitignore. Reported adaptive-attack headline cells therefore remain strong primary-study numerical evidence, not independently replayed results.
